description: Memories' rules every client answers alike (ADR 0155 decision 7.3, § Memories' move): `aspect` — a medium's display aspect (MediaGridLayout.displayAspect; a null side is unknown), `grid` — the justified gallery grid (MediaGridLayout.justify; a null aspect is unknown), `medoid` — a Memory's auto position (MemoryLocation.medoid; points are [lat, lng]), `participants` — the merge on a conflict (Participants.merge), `mp3Frame`, `adtsFrame`, `frameChain`, `adtsCount`, `adtsEnd` — the audio frame headers and a raw ADTS file's count (music/Frames), `wavHeader`, `wavSamples`, `wavEnds` — a WAV's header, its samples and the bytes of its ends (music/Wav; bytes are base64, a refusal is {"error": its message}). Inputs are kept; every `expected` is written by the core's MemoriesVectorsTest (VEYQ_WRITE_VECTORS=1 ./gradlew :apps:memories:jvmTest --tests '*MemoriesVectorsTest*'). Read through @veyq/core-js/memories by the package's memories.test.ts and through the web's glue by features/memories/vectors.test.ts.

grid.name: rows close exactly, no widow: the last gap taken back
a widow row keeps the target height
unknown, zero and negative aspects fall back to 4:3
a wide screen's gallery, widows out

medoid.name: two: a tie, the lower index
three on a line: the middle

participants.name: stored first, then the editor's new ones

adtsFrame.name: with a CRC: nine header bytes
with a CRC, too short for it
a rate index past the table

frameChain.name: MP3: a header alone is no chain
MP3: two frames are no chain of three
MP3: two frames are a chain of two

adtsCount.name: a whole file in one slice
a slice cut inside a frame: read on from its header
the file's last frame cut short is counted
a frame exactly at the end
